 Elizabeth Holmes’ partner Billy Evans sits down for his first-ever TV interview to discuss Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim’s documentary You Can See Everything . The full conversation airs on the Nov. 15 episode of CBS Sunday Morning at 6 a.m. PT/9 a.m. ET on CBS, available to stream live via DirecTV (with a five-day free trial ), Fubo (with a five-day free trial ) or Hulu + Live TV .
 stream interview online free with directv 5-day trial 
 Alternatively, Sunday’s episode will be available to stream both live and on-demand with a Paramount+ Premium subscription or on-demand following the broadcast with Paramount+ Essential , and while the service no longer offers a free trial of its own, Paramount+ Premium is currently complimentary for three months with DirecTV’s Entertainment, Choice or Ultimate Signature packages . Alternatively, the Premier package , DirecTV’s top-tier Signature package , includes Paramount+ Premium at no extra cost as part of its premium channel lineup. These are both on top of DirecTV’s standard five-day free trial .

 At a Glance: How to Watch Billy Evans on CBS Sunday Morning 
 When: Sunday, Nov. 15, 6 a.m. PT/9 a.m. ET 
 TV channel: CBS
 Stream online: DirecTV , Fubo , Hulu + Live TV ; available to on-demand following the broadcast with Paramount+ Essential or live and on-demand with Paramount+ Premium (which is also available via DirecTV , included in its free trial )
 Where to Watch Billy Evans on CBS Sunday Morning : Air Date and Time, Channel 
 The episode airs Sunday, Nov. 15 at 6 a.m. PT/9 a.m. ET on CBS. 
 Where to Stream Billy Evans CBS Sunday Morning Interview Online Free 
 CBS Sunday Morning is available to watch live on any streaming service that carries CBS network, namely DirecTV (with a five-day free trial ), Fubo (also with a five-day free trial ) and Hulu + Live TV .
 stream episode live with directv free trial 
 The episode will also be available to stream live with a Paramount+ Premium subscription or on-demand following the broadcast with Paramount+ Essential . While the service no longer offers a free trial of its own, customers can claim three complimentary months of Paramount+ Premium (and a host of other add-ons ) with DirecTV’s Entertainment, Choice or Ultimate packages , which also offer the aforementioned five-day free trial period . Alternatively, the Premier package , DirecTV’s top-tier package, includes Paramount+ indefinitely as part of its standard streaming lineup.
 get directv free trial with paramount+ premium included 
 More on each streaming option below.
 DIRECTV DirecTV 
 Five-day free trial; packages from $20.99 per month Directv free trial CBS is included in any of DirecTV’s Signature packages : Entertainment, Choice, Ultimate and Premier. Plus, DirecTV offers a five-day free trial for its streaming service, meaning new subscribers can tune in to Sunday’s interview at no cost. 
 To claim the free trial, select your preferred Signature package . Once it prompts you to choose how many Gemini devices you’d like to connect, you’ll select “0 – Stream without the Gemini Air” as the five-day free trial is only available to customers without a leased Gemini device.
 Learn more about each plan option, including how to build your own channel lineup (starting at just $20.99 per month), at directv.com .
 Fubo Fubo 
 Five-day free trial; packages from $64.99 per month ($54.99 for first month) Fubo Free trial CBS is available to stream with a subscription to Fubo , which offers a five-day free trial for new subscribers. After the trial, plans start at $54.99 for the first month and $64.99 monthly thereafter. 
 Paramount+ 
 Packages from $8.99 per month or $89.99 per year get Paramount+ Paramount+ Essential is the streamer’s ad-supported base package, costing $8.99 per month or $89.99 annually. 
 Paramount+ Premium (formerly known as Paramount+ with Showtime) is $13.99 per month or $139.99 per year and offers everything in the essential plan without ads (except for live TV), plus access to all of Showtime, the ability to stream CBS live with more sports and events, the option to download movies and shows and the ability to watch in 4K Ultra HD, Dolby Vision or HDR10.
 Hulu Hulu + Live TV 
 Packages from $89.99 per month Get Hulu + live TV Watch CBS with Hulu + Live TV . Subscriptions come bundled with Disney+ and ESPN+, and start at $89.99 per month.
